summary: The admitted baseline stops in do.c:flooreffects because js/do.js omits its NO_KILLER_PREFIX import. The import is fixed; the committed replay now reaches the trapped-hero boulder branch and matches through step 264, then stops at step 265 on the separate unported trap.c:selftouch path.
